On the first beat he wags his raised finger at camera, mock-stern; on the next he tips his head up to the sky, exasperated; then he mimes holding a dainty invisible slice of cake between thumb and finger, little finger out, raises it to chin height, stops dead, and shakes his head at the lens; then he slides the empty hand forward, offering it to the viewer, and wags the finger again.
